name: s036-new-task-dialog
note: Recorded on the route1 Linux stack (no tasks). The sidebar `New task` row opens the `Schedule a task` create dialog (editor-dialog chunk, `codex-dialog` top-positioned at y 83, 680x422, radius 30, bg surface-elevated-secondary) over a `codex-dialog-overlay` rgba(0,0,0,0.5) with backdrop blur(1px). The ProseMirror instructions editor (`Instructions…`) takes focus; Create is disabled (opacity 0.4) while empty. Escape, Cancel, `Close dialog` and an overlay click close it and leave nothing focused. The original uses a memory router: location never changes.

steps.note: the editor chunk loads lazily: the dialog mounted 300 to 1900 ms after the click in three runs
pointer parked under the dialog on the overlay
click on the dimmed overlay outside the dialog
